newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sumitomo Corp enters Pakistan's telecoms market.
newsitem.headline: Sumitomo Corp enters Pakistan's telecoms market.

text.p: Sumitomo Corp said on Monday that it had bought a five percent stake in a telecoms firm in Pakistan with the aim of entering the burgeoning market for various telecommunications services in the country.
The Pakistani firm, PDS Ltd, obtained the government's approval to offer telecommunications services in July 1994.
PDS hopes to offer domestic and international call services as well as electronic mail and Internet services, using small satellite relay stations.
PDS expects to post annual sales of about five billion yen in three years' time, Sumitomo said in a statement.
PDS belongs to the Pakistani financial group Arfeen International Ltd.
